PLAN "12-week Vegan Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain (hypertrophy)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Leg Accessory + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
